observations.text: SEND-TRNADD-SCREEN always issues CICS RETURN, so every PERFORM of it ends the task; the IF ERR-FLG-ON block that clears the data fields at the start of VALIDATE-INPUT-DATA-FIELDS can therefore never be true (Inferred) and the 'first error wins' behaviour relies on this implicit exit.

CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED (by name a selected transaction id) is moved into the card number field on first entry; no program under app/cbl sets this commarea extension, so the pre-fill path is not used by any program found (Inferred from grep of app/cbl).

When both account and card number are entered, the account wins and the typed card number is silently replaced by the card returned from the CXACAIX alternate-index read (for an account with several cards, which card is returned depends on the AIX order).
Transaction id generation (read highest id, add 1, write) is not serialized; concurrent adds can compute the same id and the second write fails with 'Tran ID already exist...' (Inferred).

The type and category codes are only checked for being numeric; they are not validated against the transaction type/category reference data, and no card status, expiry, account status, credit limit or balance check is made before the transaction is written.
CEEDAYS message 2513 (unsupported range) is accepted as a valid date for both orig and proc dates.
The user enters the processing date; TRAN-ORIG-TS and TRAN-PROC-TS receive only the 10-character date, the time part of the 26-character timestamp is left blank.
PF5 copies data from the globally last transaction in TRANSACT, not the last transaction of the entered account/card.
ENDBR response and RECEIVE MAP response are not checked.
WS-ACCTDAT-FILE, WS-USR-MODIFIED, WS-TRAN-AMT, WS-TRAN-DATE and the CVACT01Y account record are declared but unused.
DISPLAY statements are used for file errors in a CICS program.

paragraphs.logic: Resets flags and the message. With EIBCALEN 0 it XCTLs to COSGN00C. On first entry it sets CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, clears the map and, if CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED is non-blank, moves it into the card number field and performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; then sends the screen. On re-entry it receives the map and evaluates EIBAID: ENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, PF3 -> XCTL to CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM or COMEN01C, PF4 -> clear screen, PF5 -> copy last transaction data, other -> 'Invalid key pressed. Please see below...'. Ends with CICS RETURN TRANSID(CT02).
paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA

paragraphs.logic: Performs VALIDATE-INPUT-KEY-FIELDS and VALIDATE-INPUT-DATA-FIELDS, then evaluates CONFIRMI: 'Y'/'y' -> ADD-TRANSACTION; 'N'/'n'/SPACES/LOW-VALUES -> 'Confirm to add this transaction...'; anything else -> 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...'.
paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY

paragraphs.logic: If an account id is entered it must be numeric ('Account ID must be Numeric...'); it is converted with NUMVAL, looked up in CXACAIX and the cross-reference card number is moved to the card field. Else if a card number is entered it must be numeric ('Card Number must be Numeric...'), is looked up in CCXREF and the cross-reference account id is moved to the account field. If neither is entered: 'Account or Card Number must be entered...'.
paragraphs.name: VALIDATE-INPUT-KEY-FIELDS

paragraphs.logic: Clears the data fields if the error flag is on, then checks in order that type, category, source, description, amount, orig date, proc date, merchant id, name, city and zip are not empty; type and category numeric; amount in format sign + 8 digits + '.' + 2 digits; both dates in format YYYY-MM-DD; the amount is normalised via NUMVAL-C to +99999999.99; both dates are validated by CSUTLDTC (error unless severity '0000' or message 2513); merchant id numeric. Each failure sets a specific message and sends the screen.
paragraphs.name: VALIDATE-INPUT-DATA-FIELDS

paragraphs.logic: Browses TRANSACT backwards from HIGH-VALUES to get the highest TRAN-ID, adds 1 to form the new id, initializes TRAN-RECORD and fills it from the screen (type, category, source, description, NUMVAL-C amount, card number, merchant id/name/city/zip, orig and proc dates into TRAN-ORIG-TS/TRAN-PROC-TS), then performs WRITE-TRANSACT-FILE.
paragraphs.name: ADD-TRANSACTION

paragraphs.logic: Validates the key fields, reads the last record of TRANSACT (highest TRAN-ID) and, if no error, copies its type, category, source, amount, description, orig/proc timestamps and merchant fields to the screen, then performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY.
paragraphs.name: COPY-LAST-TRAN-DATA

paragraphs.logic: Defaults CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM to COSGN00C when blank, sets CDEMO-FROM-TRANID/PROGRAM to CT02/COTRN02C, zeroes CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT and XCTLs to CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM.
paragraphs.name: RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN

paragraphs.logic: Fills the header, moves WS-MESSAGE to ERRMSGO, sends map COTRN2A with ERASE and CURSOR and immediately issues CICS RETURN TRANSID(CT02), ending the task.
paragraphs.name: SEND-TRNADD-SCREEN

paragraphs.logic: Receives map COTRN2A of mapset COTRN02 into COTRN2AI; RESP/RESP2 are captured but not tested.
paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-TRNADD-SCREEN

paragraphs.logic: Moves FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE to WS-CURDATE-DATA, CCDA-TITLE01/CCDA-TITLE02 to TITLE01O/TITLE02O, WS-TRANID to TRNNAMEO and WS-PGMNAME to PGMNAMEO of COTRN2AO; rebuilds the date as WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY (MM/DD/YY from WS-CURDATE-MONTH, WS-CURDATE-DAY, WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2)) into CURDATEO and the time as WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS into CURTIMEO.
paragraphs.name: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO

paragraphs.logic: Reads CXACAIX (card cross-reference by account id) into CARD-XREF-RECORD keyed by XREF-ACCT-ID. NOTFND -> 'Account ID NOT found...'; other errors DISPLAY RESP/RESP2 and show 'Unable to lookup Acct in XREF AIX file...'.
paragraphs.name: READ-CXACAIX-FILE

paragraphs.logic: Reads CCXREF into CARD-XREF-RECORD keyed by XREF-CARD-NUM. NOTFND -> 'Card Number NOT found...'; other errors DISPLAY RESP/RESP2 and show 'Unable to lookup Card # in XREF file...'.
paragraphs.name: READ-CCXREF-FILE

paragraphs.logic: Starts a browse on TRANSACT at TRAN-ID. NOTFND -> 'Transaction ID NOT found...'; other errors -> 'Unable to lookup Transaction...'.
paragraphs.name: STARTBR-TRANSACT-FILE

paragraphs.logic: Reads the previous TRANSACT record into TRAN-RECORD. ENDFILE (empty file) sets TRAN-ID to zeros; other errors -> 'Unable to lookup Transaction...'.
paragraphs.name: READPREV-TRANSACT-FILE

paragraphs.logic: Issues EXEC CICS ENDBR on DATASET(WS-TRANSACT-FILE) to end the browse; no RESP option is coded, so the response is not checked.
paragraphs.name: ENDBR-TRANSACT-FILE

paragraphs.logic: Writes TRAN-RECORD to TRANSACT keyed by TRAN-ID. NORMAL clears the fields and shows in green 'Transaction added successfully.  Your Tran ID is <TRAN-ID>.'; DUPKEY/DUPREC -> 'Tran ID already exist...'; other -> 'Unable to Add Transaction...'.
paragraphs.name: WRITE-TRANSACT-FILE

paragraphs.logic: Performs INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS and sends the empty screen.
paragraphs.name: CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN

paragraphs.logic: Puts the cursor on the account field and moves SPACES to all key, data and confirm input fields and to WS-MESSAGE.
paragraphs.name: INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS

messages: Invalid key pressed. Please see below...
rules.outcome: XCTL, clear, copy, process or invalid-key message
rules.statement: Without a commarea the program returns to sign-on COSGN00C. On re-entry ENTER processes the add request, PF3 returns to the calling program (or COMEN01C when none is recorded), PF4 clears the screen, PF5 copies the last transaction's data, and any other key shows 'Invalid key pressed. Please see below...'.

rules.anchor: MOVE CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED TO CARDNINI OF COTRN2AI
rules.conditions: First entry and CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED not spaces/low-values
rules.outcome: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY performed with the pre-filled card number
rules.statement: On first entry, if a selected value is present in CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED of the commarea, it is placed in the card number field and the add request is processed immediately (key lookup and validation).

rules.outcome: ADD-TRANSACTION or message with cursor on CONFIRM
rules.statement: A transaction is added only after explicit confirmation 'Y' or 'y'. 'N', 'n' or blank does not cancel but asks 'Confirm to add this transaction...'; any other value gives 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...'. Confirmation is evaluated only after all key and data validations passed.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Account or Card Number must be entered...' TO WS-MESSAGE
messages: Account or Card Number must be entered...
Unable to lookup Acct in XREF AIX file...
Unable to lookup Card # in XREF file...
rules.outcome: Account and card fields populated from CARD-XREF-RECORD, or error message
rules.statement: The transaction must be tied to a card in the card cross-reference: if an account id is entered it must be numeric and exist in CXACAIX, and the cross-reference card number replaces the card field; otherwise a numeric card number must be entered and exist in CCXREF, and its account id is filled in. Account id takes precedence when both are entered; if neither is entered the request is rejected.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Type CD can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE
messages: Type CD can NOT be empty...
Category CD can NOT be empty...
Orig Date can NOT be empty...
Proc Date can NOT be empty...
Merchant ID can NOT be empty...
Merchant Name can NOT be empty...
Merchant City can NOT be empty...
Merchant Zip can NOT be empty...
rules.outcome: Error message, cursor on field, task ends
rules.statement: All transaction data fields are mandatory and are checked in this order: type code, category code, source, description, amount, orig date, proc date, merchant id, merchant name, merchant city, merchant zip; the first empty field is reported ('<Field> can NOT be empty...').

rules.anchor: WHEN TTYPCDI OF COTRN2AI NOT NUMERIC
rules.outcome: 'Type CD must be Numeric...' / 'Category CD must be Numeric...'
rules.statement: Transaction type code and category code must be numeric.

rules.anchor: WHEN TRNAMTI OF COTRN2AI(1:1) NOT EQUAL '-' AND '+'
rules.conditions: Position 1 not sign, 2-9 not numeric, 10 not '.', 11-12 not numeric
rules.statement: The amount must be entered exactly as a sign ('+' or '-'), 8 digits, a decimal point and 2 digits (format -99999999.99); it is then converted with NUMVAL-C and redisplayed as +99999999.99.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Orig Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD' TO WS-MESSAGE
rules.conditions: Any position of TORIGDTI/TPROCDTI violates the layout
messages: Orig Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD
Proc Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD
rules.outcome: 'Orig Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD' / 'Proc Date should be in format YYYY-MM-DD'
rules.statement: Origination and processing dates must have the layout YYYY-MM-DD (4 digits, '-', 2 digits, '-', 2 digits).

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Proc Date - Not a valid date...'
messages: Orig Date - Not a valid date...
Proc Date - Not a valid date...
rules.outcome: 'Orig Date - Not a valid date...' / 'Proc Date - Not a valid date...'
rules.statement: Origination and processing dates must be valid calendar dates according to CSUTLDTC/CEEDAYS; a non-zero severity is rejected unless the CEEDAYS message number is 2513 (unsupported range), which is accepted.

rules.anchor: IF MIDI OF COTRN2AI IS NOT NUMERIC

rules.statement: The new transaction id is the highest TRAN-ID currently in TRANSACT plus 1 (TRAN-ID treated as a 16-digit number); when the file is empty the first id is 1.

rules.anchor: MOVE TPROCDTI OF COTRN2AI TO TRAN-PROC-TS
rules.statement: The new transaction record is built from the screen: type, category, source, description, amount (NUMVAL-C of the entered amount), card number (from the cross-reference lookup), merchant id/name/city/zip, and the 10-character orig/proc dates stored in the 26-character TRAN-ORIG-TS/TRAN-PROC-TS fields.

rules.anchor: MOVE 'Tran ID already exist...' TO WS-MESSAGE
rules.statement: Writing the transaction: success clears the screen and shows 'Transaction added successfully.  Your Tran ID is <id>.' in green; a duplicate key gives 'Tran ID already exist...'; any other error gives 'Unable to Add Transaction...'.

rules.anchor: MOVE TRAN-MERCHANT-ID TO MIDI OF COTRN2AI
rules.outcome: Screen data fields copied from last TRAN-RECORD; PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
rules.statement: PF5 pre-fills the data fields with those of the last transaction in TRANSACT (highest TRAN-ID, regardless of account or card) after validating the key fields, and then runs the normal add processing, which still requires confirmation.
When returning to a previous screen with no target program set, the sign-on program COSGN00C is used.

sme_questions.question: Which program is expected to populate CDEMO-CT02-TRN-SELECTED, and is a transaction id really meant to be used as a card number on first entry?
Should online-added transactions validate type/category codes against reference data and check card/account status or credit limit, or is that deferred to batch posting?
Is it intended that 'N' does not cancel the add but only re-prompts for confirmation?
Should the processing date be user-entered, and should a time component be stored in TRAN-ORIG-TS/TRAN-PROC-TS?
Is there a requirement to serialize transaction id generation (e.g. via ENQ or a control record) to avoid duplicate-key failures under concurrency?

summary.text: COTRN02C is a pseudo-conversational CICS program (transaction CT02, mapset COTRN02, map COTRN2A) that adds a new transaction record to the TRANSACT VSAM file. The user identifies the card either by account number (resolved to a card through the CXACAIX alternate index of the card cross-reference) or by card number (resolved to an account through CCXREF), then enters type code, category code, source, description, amount (format -99999999.99), origination and processing dates (YYYY-MM-DD, validated with CSUTLDTC) and merchant id, name, city and zip. After the user confirms with Y, the next transaction id is computed as the highest existing TRAN-ID plus 1 (STARTBR/READPREV from HIGH-VALUES) and the record is written; the user sees 'Transaction added successfully.  Your Tran ID is <id>.'. PF4 clears the screen, PF5 copies the data fields of the last transaction in the file, PF3 returns to the calling program or the main menu COMEN01C. Every screen send ends the task with CICS RETURN, so the first validation error stops processing.
